sources.name: NIC HealthGIS Public Health Facilities (Government of India)
sources.description: Comprehensive geocoded directory of public hospitals, community health centres (CHCs), and primary health centres (PHCs) from National Informatics Centre HealthGIS.

sources.name: Karnataka State KGIS Health Facilities (Government of Karnataka)
sources.description: Geocoded state healthcare facility directory including dispensaries, taluk hospitals, and clinics from Karnataka State Remote Sensing Applications Centre.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap / HOT India Nationwide Healthcare Infrastructure
sources.description: Nationwide OpenStreetMap export of hospitals, clinics, diagnostic labs, pharmacies, and healthcare professionals with coordinates and amenity tags.

sources.name: Indian Pharmaceutical Products & Formulations Database
sources.description: Authentic database of Indian pharmaceutical products spanning brand names, generic compositions, manufacturers, price (INR), pack size, and formulation types.

sources.name: World Health Organization (WHO) India Health Indicators
sources.description: Multi-year disease prevalence, immunization rates, health systems capacity, and epidemiological indicators for India published by WHO.

sources.name: World Bank India Demographic & Health Systems Indicators
sources.description: Longitudinal health expenditure, maternal health, child mortality, and life expectancy time-series indicators for India.

sources.name: USAID / DHS India Subnational Health & Demographic Indicators
sources.description: Subnational health statistics, nutritional indicators, and fertility statistics across all Indian states and union territories.

sources.name: PhysioNet MIMIC-IV Clinical Laboratory Measurements
sources.description: Standardized, de-identified clinical chemistry and hematology lab measurements with numeric values, units, reference flags, and test identifiers.

sources.name: PhysioNet MIMIC-IV Clinical Laboratory Items Dictionary
sources.description: Dictionary of clinical laboratory tests, specimen fluids, and reference categories.

sources.name: ICD-10-CM Clinical Diagnosis & Pathology Terminology
sources.description: Complete ICD-10 clinical diagnosis code catalog, disease descriptions, clinical categories, and diagnostic terminology.

sources.name: HealthcareMagic Clinical Decision & Medical Knowledge QA
sources.description: Physician-verified clinical questions and explanations covering symptomatology, differential diagnosis, and management guidelines.

sources.name: National Medical Register (NMC)
sources.description: National registry of verified doctors under the National Medical Commission. Unrestricted automated bulk programmatic extraction is rate-limited and prohibited by Terms of Service. Authorized institutional import API workflow provided in backend/scripts/import_doctor_registry.py.

sources.name: Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM) Health Facility Registry
sources.description: Official ABDM health facility registry. Nationwide bulk exports require authenticated client credentials from the National Health Authority (NHA).

sources.name: Multi-Center Clinical Laboratory Dataset (MCLD) - Mendeley Data
sources.description: 145,288 clinical laboratory records from 3 accredited medical laboratories. Mendeley portal requires manual single-sign-on or manual zip download into data/raw/laboratory/mcld/.
